goal.title: 1 · A column is a line
goal.text:
Click a cell on the plate and type a word; Enter places it and moves up. A column is read from the bottom to the top, and the top brick acts on everything below it.

Make the program print hello.

steps.text: Click a cell on the plate. Type hello and press Enter: the word becomes a brick and the cursor moves up.
Type > and press Enter. The column now reads hello > from the bottom up: > prints the line.
Press Run (F5). The output shows hello.
Press Check to see the stars.
